text.offer: Oxal ix'Tokak, in Ko'catan, has asked for supplies of our brew for his customers on the other side. Please take this ale to him; I have arranged for Oxal to pay you for the journey. Do not steal my goods. But let us not dwell on the seedier side of life: this could be the beginning of something very profitable for all involved, my friend!
text.complete: I see D'Franco has kept his word. This is very good. I am sure that this is the beginning of a mutually beneficial relationship. Here is a token of my gratitude.
